title: Checkout Session create returns 400 for payment_method_types on API version 2026-09-30.endive
symptoms: 400 invalid_request_error naming the payment_method_types parameter on checkout.sessions.create
Code that worked on 2026-08-26.dahlia breaks right after upgrading to stripe-node 23 or another SDK pinned to endive
TypeScript: payment_method_types does not exist in type Checkout.SessionCreateParams
cause: The endive major release removed payment_method_types as a request parameter on Checkout Sessions, and on Payment Intents and Setup Intents too. SDK majors that pin endive, such as stripe-node 23, also drop it from their param types.
fix: Remove payment_method_types. Either let dynamic payment methods from the Dashboard decide, or pass allowed_payment_method_types, which quietly filters out methods that do not fit the currency or amount instead of failing.
affected: Stripe API 2026-09-30.endive and later; stripe-node 23.0.0 and other SDK majors pinned to endive, released 2026-09-30
